title: mentha aquatica var. pilosa
intro: Mentha aquatica var. pilosa, commonly known as American Watermint, is a variant of the American Watermint plant, a species of mint native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, relieve respiratory problems, and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of American Watermint include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesia, anti-anxiety, and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions, including its ability to calm digestive issues and reduce fever, have been attributed to its ability to relax the smooth muscles and stimulate the immune system.
